answer: Fork-Probe Divergence Test. Each identity must answer a randomly targeted, context-specific query drawn from a private sable dataset; clones sharing one backend return identical answers. Probe two suspected clones with disjoint query subsets: genuine distinct agents diverge, clones cannot. The lagoon of shared state exposes them. Passing requires independent provisioning, so each identity pays the lotus cost: a separate model instance with its own weights and memory.
